name: adbc_info
description: Return driver and server metadata for an attached ADBC database — vendor name, version strings, supported features.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

name: adbc_clear_cache
description: Use CALL to invalidate schema and table metadata for attached ADBC catalogs after remote DDL. Returns cleared BOOLEAN (false if none are attached). Does not reload drivers or flush connection pools; ordinary data changes need no cache clear.

returnsTable.name: cleared
returnsTable.description: Whether attached ADBC catalog metadata was cleared.

name: adbc_scan
description: Run SQL on an attached ADBC database and stream its result as a DuckDB table. Planning uses ExecuteSchema and never executes the query to infer columns. Drivers without ExecuteSchema, including SQLite, require a columns STRUCT declaring the complete ordered result schema.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameter values as a STRUCT, such as row(1).

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Requested rows per batch; support depends on the driver.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Complete ordered result schema, such as {'id': 'BIGINT'}. Required when ExecuteSchema is unsupported.

returns: Columns follow the complete remote result schema, inferred from driver metadata or supplied with columns.

name: adbc_scan_table
description: Read a named table using GetTableSchema metadata and a generated SELECT with supported projection and filter pushdown. Supply columns to override unavailable or unsuitable metadata.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

parameters.name: catalog
parameters.description: Remote catalog name.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Remote schema name.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Requested rows per batch.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Optional complete ordered schema override.

returns: Columns follow the complete remote result schema, inferred from driver metadata or supplied with columns.

name: adbc_execute
description: Use standalone CALL to execute remote DDL or DML at runtime on an attached ADBC database. Inside BEGIN … COMMIT it joins the attachment's transaction; otherwise it autocommits on the attachment's own connection, so session state such as temp tables and SET carries across calls. Returns one rows_affected BIGINT row, or NULL when unknown. PREPARE and ordinary EXPLAIN do not execute the command; EXPLAIN ANALYZE does. Rejected on a READ_ONLY attachment.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

returnsTable.name: rows_affected
returnsTable.description: Affected row count, or NULL when unknown.

name: adbc_insert
description: Pass a DuckDB query's Arrow batches to the driver's bulk ingestion API. Modes: create, append, replace, create_append. Inside BEGIN … COMMIT it joins the attachment's transaction. Rejected on a READ_ONLY attachment. Stream binding and execution run together on a consumer thread, so drivers that read their input during BindStream ingest without blocking.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Ingestion mode: 'create', 'append', 'replace', or 'create_append'.

parameters.name: max_batches
parameters.description: Maximum Arrow batches queued between the DuckDB producer and the ingest consumer.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Driver-specific statement options as a STRUCT or MAP, e.g. {'adbc.ingest.temporary': 'true'}. Applied after the target table and mode; keys adbc_insert sets itself are rejected.

name: adbc_tables
description: List tables visible to an attached ADBC database. Returns name, schema, and table type — driver-dependent filters available.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

name: adbc_table_types
description: List the table-type categories the driver/server distinguishes (e.g. TABLE / VIEW / SYSTEM TABLE).

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

name: adbc_columns
description: Describe the columns of a table — name, type, nullability, default — pulled from the driver's catalog API.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

name: adbc_schema
description: Describe a named table through the driver's GetTableSchema metadata API. The second argument is a table name, not an SQL query.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Alias of an ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) database. Unknown or non-ADBC names fail at bind.

name: adbc_profiles
description: List locally discoverable ADBC connection profiles. Optionally supply additional profile search paths.

parameters.name: search_paths
parameters.description: Additional profile search paths.
